description: Public package topology for the hummbl-io/oss monorepo. Contains only packages published from this public repo — no private repo names, infrastructure details, or fleet inventory. Base120 codes are P/IN/CO/DE/RE/SY 1-20 only.

repo_fields.name: package directory name (hummbl-<X>)
repo_fields.primary_base120: The single Base120 model that best captures the package's core intent
repo_fields.layer: Architectural layer (L0 Meta, L1 Safety, L2 Technical, L3 Coordination, L4 Strategy, L5 Human, L6 Operations)
repo_fields.bridges: Array of package names this package explicitly connects to (cross-layer or cross-domain)

L0.name: Meta
L0.description: Cross-cutting shared infrastructure, intelligence, and taxonomy

L1.name: Safety
L1.description: Governance, compliance, adversarial testing, and risk

L2.name: Technical

L3.name: Coordination
L3.description: Bus, mesh, agent orchestration, and shared memory

L5.name: Human
L5.description: Belonging, cognition, health, and founder support

L6.name: Operations
L6.description: Production, runtime, live services, and tooling
